dossier.scp_unleashed.173.title: The Sculpture
dossier.scp_unleashed.173.caption: SCP-173 in its cell during an inspection. Two staff held the look while this was taken.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-173 is to be kept in a locked cell with thick walls and a heavy door that it cannot push open. **Personnel entering the cell must go in pairs, and at least one must keep their eyes on SCP-173 at all times.** Whoever holds the look is to say so aloud before looking away or blinking.
A brown residue gathers on the cell floor. It is to be scraped up on every visit. %rCleaning is never to be postponed.%r
Instances of SCP-131 may be stationed with SCP-173. They do not appear to tire of watching it.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-173 is a lanky figure a little under 2 m tall, built from rough chunks of concrete on bent lengths of steel rebar. A crude face is sprayed onto its head in red-brown paint, two lengths of wire stand up from it, and a hole in its torso shows crossed rebar inside.

SCP-173 is animate and hostile, but it cannot move while anyone has it in sight. When nobody is watching it moves very quickly, and the scrape of stone on stone is often heard from the cell. Each time it is seen again it stands in a different pose.
Anyone it reaches while unobserved dies at once. %rWitnesses describe a single sharp crack.%r

page.title: Addendum 173-1: Recovery
page.text: SCP-173 has no recovery record. It was first found standing a short way behind a researcher who had just finished reading this file. %rNobody saw it arrive.%r It has done the same to later readers.

page.title: Addendum 173-2: Incident Log
page.text: During a period when the cell went uncleaned, a second figure was found standing among the residue. %rIt could be told apart from the original only on close inspection.%r See incident report 173-C.

block.scp_unleashed.scp173_residue.toolt: A dried brown crust, left wherever the sculpture has stood.
block.scp_unleashed.scp173_residue.clean: Clear it with a shovel or a decal scraper
block.scp_unleashed.scp173_residue.warni: Staff are told never to let it pile up.
SCP-173, the Sculpture: a lanky figure of rough concrete on bent rebar, with a face sprayed on in red-brown paint. Euclid-class.
It cannot move while anyone is watching it. When nobody is, it moves very fast, and anyone it reaches dies at once.
It never spawns naturally. Reading the SCP-173 dossier at an Archive Terminal brings it to the reader. Operators can use /scp_unleashed scp173 with spawn, clone, residue or status.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp173_residue.1: A brown crust that SCP-173 leaves behind as it moves, and sometimes while it stands alone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp173_residue.2: Clear it with a shovel, or scrape it away with a decal scraper. It leaves nothing behind.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp173_residue.3: Containment staff are told to clean it up on every visit, and never to let it build up.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp173.spawn.fail: There is no room for SCP-173 here.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp173.clone.fail: There is no room for a copy near SCP-173.

commands.scp_unleashed.scp173.residue.fa: There is no floor here for residue.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp173.status.wat: Watched by %s players (%s) and %s eye pods.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp173.0: It comes to whoever reads this file. Watch your back.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp173.1: Once you have it in sight, do not look away.
gamerule.scp173Cloning: SCP-173: copies grow from its residue
gamerule.scp173Cloning.description: When off, SCP-173 no longer forms new copies of itself from its residue. Copies that already exist stay, and the operator clone command still works.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp173.status.cli: It is clinging to a wall.
